paite: Huan Nebat tapa kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawm-le-giat alal kum in Judahte tung ah Abijam alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Abijam / (2 Kro 13.1-14.1)

paite: Jerusalem ah kum thum alal a; anu min Maakah, Abishalom tanu ahi.
Ama a pan thil gilou ahih tengteng ama'n leng ahih sam ahi. Apu David bang in alungtang TOUPA a Pathian lam ah ahoihkim sam kei hi.
Himahleh David ziak in TOUPA a Pathian in anung a, atapa hong dinkhiakna ding leh Jerusalem khua dingkipsak ding in Jerusalem ah khawnvak apia hi.
Hit mi Uriah tungtang chih louh in David in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih ahih ziak leh adamsung teng a hih dia thu apiak peuhmah asel ngei louh ziak in.
Rehoboam adamsung teng Jeroboam toh akidou gige uhi.
Abijam tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw? Abijam leh Jeroboam akidou uhi.
Abijam apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; David khopi ah avui uhi. Ama sik in atapa Asa alal hi.
Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawmnih alal kum in Asa bel Judahte tung ah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Asa / (2 Kro 14.1-5; 15.16—16.6,11-14)

paite: Kum sawmli-le-khat Jerusalem ah alal a; anu min Maakah ahi a, amah Abishalom tanu ahi.
Asa in apu David mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
Pasal kizuakte gam a pan adelhkhia a; apute'n milim ana bawl tengteng uh alamang hi.
Anu Maakah leng, milim kihhuai mahmah Asherah abawlsak ziak in, akumpinu hihna atawpsak hi. Amilim bawl ahihsia a, Kidron lui ah ahal hi.
Mun sangte ahihleh alamang kei a; himahleh Asa lungtang adamsung teng in TOUPA lam ah ahoih bukim hi.
Apa'n thil ana latsate leh amah mah in ana latsa dangka, dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan TOUPA' inn ah alalut hi.
Asa leh Israel kumpipa Baasha lal sung teng akidou gige uhi.
heading: Asa Leh Ben-hadad Pankhawmna / (2 Kro 16.1-14)

paite: Israel kumpipa Baasha in Judah ava dou a, Judah kumpipa Asa kiang a lut ding leh pawtkhe ding dalna ding in Ramah khua abawl hi.

Huchi in Asa in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou om lai dangka leh dangka-eng tengteng ala a, asikhate apia hi. Huchi in kumpipa Asa in Damaskas a om Siria kumpipa Hezion tapate Tabrimon tapa Ben-hadad kiang ah,

"Kei leh nang kikal ah leh ka pa leh na pa kikal ah thukhun a-om a; ngai in, thilpiak dangka leh dangka-eng ka hon khak hi. Hong pai inla, Israel kumpipa Baasha in ahon paisanna ding in amah toh na thukhun uh hihsia in," chi in akhak hi.
Ben-hadad in kumpipa Asa thu ana pom a, Israel khuate dou ding in asepaih heutute asawl a, Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maakah khuate, Kinneroth bial tengteng leh Naphtali gam tengteng tan in adou hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Baasha in huai thu ana zaktak in Ramah abawl atawp a, Tirzah ah atengta hi.

Kumpipa Asa in Judah gam tengteng ah thu athangsak vialvial hi. Kuamah om awl a-om kei uh. Huchi in Baasha in Ramah khua bawlna dia suang leh sing azatte anawn ua; huaite zang in kumpipa Asa in Mizpah khua leh Benjamin gam a Geba khua abawl hi.
Asa tanchin dang tengteng, athilhihdan tengteng, athilhih tengtengte leh akho bawlte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw? Himahleh atek lam in akhe ahong nata hi.
Huchi in a-ihmuta a, apu David khopi ah apute lak ah avui ua; atapa Jehoshaphat asik in alal hi.
Jeroboam tapa Nadab Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum nihna ah Israel tung ah alal pan a, Israel tung ah kum nih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Nadab

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih a, apa lampi atawn a, Israelte thilhih akhialsak a, ahihkhelhna pentak ama'n leng ahih sam hi.
Issakar inkuante lak a mi Ahijah tapa Baasha in amah aguksawm a, Philistiate tan, Gibbethon ah Baasha in athat hi. Nadab leh Israel tengteng in Gibbethon a-um lai uh ahi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum thumna ah ahi Baasha in athah a, asik a ahong lal.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa ahong hih in Jeroboam inko tengteng athat a; Jeroboam a ding in kuamah ahinghawi kei hi. TOUPA Shiloh a mi asikha Ahijah zang a agensa bang in.
Huai bel Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahih, Jeroboam khelhnate ziak leh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahehsak ziak ahi.
Nadab tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Asa leh Israel kumpipa Baasha alal sung teng un akidou gige uh.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum thum na ah Ahijah tapa Baasha Tirzah ah Israel tengteng tung ah alal pan a, kum sawmnih-le-li alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Baasha

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, Jeroboam lampi zuih azui a, Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahihkhelhna ahih sam hi.
